device_authorizations_approval_names_pri.name: device_authorizations_approval_names_principal
device_authorizations_approval_names_pri.value:
("device_authorizations"."decision" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."principal" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."generation" = 0 AND "device_authorizations"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("device_authorizations"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "device_authorizations"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND (
          ("device_authorizations"."decision" = 'denied' AND "device_authorizations"."principal" IS NULL AND "device_authorizations"."generation" = 0 AND "device_authorizations"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("device_authorizations"."decision" = 'approved' AND "device_authorizations"."principal" IS NOT NULL AND "device_authorizations"."principal" LIKE 'user:%')
        ))

generated.as: CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL THEN subject END

project_folders_folder_check.name: project_folders_folder_check
project_folders_folder_check.value: "project_folders"."folder" IS NULL OR (char_length("project_folders"."folder") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "project_folders"."folder" !~ '[/[:cntrl:]]' AND "project_folders"."folder" = btrim("project_folders"."folder"))

secret_folders_folder_check.name: secret_folders_folder_check
secret_folders_folder_check.value: "secret_folders"."folder" IS NULL OR (char_length("secret_folders"."folder") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "secret_folders"."folder" !~ '[/[:cntrl:]]' AND "secret_folders"."folder" = btrim("secret_folders"."folder"))

vault_grants_on_every_project.name: vault_grants_on_every_project
vault_grants_on_every_project.where: "vault_grants"."project_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" IS NULL

vault_grants_one_place.name: vault_grants_one_place
vault_grants_one_place.value: (("vault_grants"."project_id" IS NULL) <> ("vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL) AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" IS NULL) OR ("vault_grants"."project_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL)

vault_grants_environment_role_check.name: vault_grants_environment_role_check
vault_grants_environment_role_check.value: ("vault_grants"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "vault_grants"."environment_slug" IS NULL) OR "vault_grants"."role" IN ('viewer', 'developer', 'auditor')
